title: Unblock a wireless device type
summary: Re-enable a specific type of wireless device, such as Wi-Fi or Bluetooth, that was previously blocked.

steps.explain: Unblock devices of a specific type. Replace <TYPE> with the device type you want to enable (e.g., wifi, bluetooth, gps, nfc).

placeholders.name: TYPE
placeholders.description: The type of wireless device to unblock (e.g., wifi, bluetooth, gps, nfc).

rollback.explain: Block the device type again if you need to disable it.

placeholders.name: TYPE
placeholders.description: The type of wireless device to block.

warnings: Unblocking a device allows it to connect to networks or pair with devices automatically if configured.
